resources.string: Quality mode preserves grayscale fidelity; speed mode may slightly shift grayscale. waifu2x 2× (anime RGB, no denoising). Prefers Vulkan GPU acceleration, with automatic CPU fallback when unavailable or on failure. CPU mode can also be selected. Translation reads the original image and draws its overlay on top. Zoom and scroll position are preserved. The memory limit adapts to available memory. Previous enhanced pages are released when turning pages. Animated images are skipped. Original files, sharing and saving are unchanged.
